This test verifies that the sensor can see you and tell you apart from other objects in the room.\r\n\r\nFor the test, make sure you're standing in the center of the play space, and that you're not in contact with another object, like a couch. Also make sure nothing is on the floor near you, like a table, pillows, or pets.
Stand 6-8 ft (1.8-2.5 m) from the sensor. You should see your head and as much of your body as possible.\r\n\r\nIf Kinect can't see enough of you, select Adjust Angle.

Make sure nothing is covering your face, like a hat, reflective glasses, or your hair. Also check for reflections or glare.

Make sure your room has enough light so that your face is clearly visible and evenly lit. Try to minimize side or back lighting, especially from a window.

If the problem persists, try placing the sensor closer to the top or bottom of the TV.

Make sure the sensor is pointing out into the room, that your lights are on, and that you're standing in the center of the play space.

If the problem persists, visit www.xbox.com/support.
